notes.title: Missions Update
notes.content:
Attention all Cleaner units,
Operation Survive has reached a major update revolving around the missions, main menu fix, and settings using .json format, UI responsiveness, graphics + sounds

[list]
[*] +4 AI Bots (Simplified but they follow and revive)

[*] Stages 0 and 1 added

[/list]

And more to come as we continue the journey!

You can catch video updates on our [b]Youtube Channel[/b] at: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@griffoninteractive]Griffon Interactive[/url]

Stay Safe 
-Griffon Interactive Director

We have been working hard to make this game worthy of the price tag and worthy of our debut in the game development environment. We appreciate not only your feedback but also the time that you have given to support us! 
We will continue to update this game until the day we officially release it, not on Early Access, but officially released!
There are more things to do and as we continue, the updates will be posted. 
Hype is what we need and we would appreciate it if you could give us your support from you and or friends and family!

notes.title: Big Planned Updates
notes.content:
Attention all Cleaner units, Hunter Project Operation Survive is going through a game mechanic redesign!
So much can be thought of in 3 months and some things are being removed or added into the game for a better promising experience!

Somethings we are working or considering on that we would love to showcase when ready:

[b] Character Customization [/b]
You will be able to customize your character for a more fitting experience. You can make Cleaner 159 the way you want. Change their hairstyle, color, gear/uniform!

[b] Story Mode [/b]
The hinted story mode is currently still being brainstormed as the storyline went through many directions and as of now could be set and stone soon! The story mode gameplay that is currently made but will be changed is the tutorial mission or Chapter 0: Prologue.

[b] AI [/b]
The AI, friendly or hostile will have a universal system, meaning that if you ally with the infected faction rather than the Griffon faction you will be targeted by Griffon soldiers. 
Not only that, the AI will be able to call in reinforcements if you don't kill them quickly. 

[b] Improved Loadout/Gear [/b]
You will be able to choose your Primary, Secondary, Melee Weapon, and the soon-to-be Gadget to fit your playstyle while on the field. And you will be able to equip different types of gear such as juggernaut gear or no gear at all. 

[b] Leveling System [/b]
As you are on the field doing expeditions or the story you can level up and increase your "combat level" so you can handle harder areas. But be aware as you go through the game and get stronger so will your enemies as they will increase in level as you go.

[b] Open World [/b]
The story mode is still gonna be a linear storyline but now with a twist. You can explore the city you are in and do side missions while meeting hostile resistance. Just like the planned expeditions you can meet survivors who could be friendly and can offer you items or be hostile and fight you. 


Those are some things we are planning.
We know it's been a while since we released the game for Early Access and not much has been done. But we would like to request from you that you stay with us and see this game to the end. We worked hard and learned as we go. We promise to make an experience that will give you a thrill!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41897256/82c20f72dce901861b8e0dd6d591ce3aa12a0f55.png[/img]

Stay Safe
-Spearhead Interactive Director

Directors note: I just finished Boot camp and now I am going to Combat Training for about 2 or so months so progress won't be apparent until maybe late November to early December! Thank you again for keeping this game in mind.

notes.title: Prepare for certain drop!
notes.content:
Attention all Cleaner units, Hunter Project Operation Survive will be launching soon! 
The last nail for Early Access Release is the tutorial mission

Things that are noteworthy:
[list]
[*] Ammo Boxes have been created and added to each available Survival Map
[*] Tutorial mission has a start and end cutscene
[*] Tutorial mission has a partially scripted story with some voice acting
[*] You can change your weapons to either the AR, SMG, or Shotgun (sniper has not been implemented)
[*] AI bots that follow will have different skins to distinguish them. Jill (Girl with ponytail), Maxim (Guy wearing medic gear), Grace (Girl with NVGs), Adam (Guy with red eyes)
[/list]
[b]After the early access release what then?[/b]
After the EA release, we plan to optimize the codes we created and update any assets such as walls, doors, etc. We also plan to start on the Campaign as well as Expeditions. We also are considering another game mode called Raids

[b]What is this Raid game mode?[/b]
Raid is a game mode where you and a few AI soldiers assault areas such as bases and outposts. Giving the feeling of action and intensity.

[b]Should I expect bugs and issues?[/b]
Yes, please expect bugs/issues to happen because Unity's Navmesh tends to bake the same navmesh from one map to another and cause pathing issues to the AI, you can cheese the infected by staying under them and receive no damage. If there are more bugs, please report them via our Discord server or any other social media. 


Stay Safe
-Spearhead Interactive Director

Directors note: When I release this game, I should note that I will be leaving for 3 months to go to military BootCamp and then begin my service for the government! I will see you then.

notes.title: Big game updates!
notes.content:
The games ambitions are high and we are making a lot of improvements, ai tweaks, combat, and model overhauls! This project began as a simple project made via a tutorial to now a self-taught game with concepts from others.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41897256/ac1a503fbfe64f1b5185794184aee00f34f12e4f.png[/img]
The game will be given lighting, environments based on the map, and eerie designs to keep the player on edge during explorations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41897256/4963767f3493dde7b7d1a9a46c9110aa187327fa.png[/img]
You aren't on your own. When playing solo you are provided with ai bots that follow you and take down threats that stand in your way
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41897256/5dcdddccba81d82eef0822eef468b13cd9c73756.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41897256/c1498bded35daad86369356908761a83f363d092.png[/img]
The infected aren't the only threat you will face. Prepare your ammo for a mercenary organization and other parties that come into the area. 

The game is constantly being developed as we speak and we could expect a big build by next year! Prepare for containment
